plan-choose.title: The Plan, choosing this week
plan-choose.job: A learner on the Plan page understands what to choose for this week, what each choice trains, and how to start the week.

A.caption: The Plan asks the learner to choose this week's element from a list of chips; the start button starts the week.

B.caption: The Plan asks what to improve this week; a line under the choice says what it trains, and the start button names the week and the choice.

history-early.title: Historial after a week or two
history-early.job: A learner with a week or two of practice opens Historial and quickly sees what they have done and what is worth looking at.

A.caption: Historial shows the practice calendar, a year map of practised days, then the saved sessions.

B.caption: Historial shows the practice calendar, then the saved sessions; the year map waits until there are a few weeks to show.

step-next.title: A guided routine, between steps
step-next.job: In a guided routine, when a step's time runs out and after the learner rates it, they know how to go on to the next step.

A.caption: A card on the stage names the next step. After a one-tap rating, the score card explains the score; its last part opens the next step.

B.caption: A card on the stage names the next step. After a one-tap rating, the score card puts the next step right under the score.

end-ask.title: Terminar in the middle of a routine
end-ask.job: A learner who taps Terminar on step 2 of a routine understands what is happening and does not lose their place by a mis-tap.

A.caption: Shown: the screen right after tapping Terminar on step 2. Terminar ends the routine and goes home; starting again begins at step 1.

B.caption: Shown: the screen right after tapping Terminar on step 2. Past the first step Terminar asks first; 'Seguir' takes Terminar's place.

tour-plan.title: The tour's Plan stop
tour-plan.job: On the tour's stop at the Plan, a newcomer learns what the Plan is for and what they would do there each week.

A.caption: The tour's third stop opens the Plan and explains it.

B.caption: The tour's third stop opens the Plan and explains it in the Plan's new words.
